steps.note: Wire them up: with the three collections declared, `manni meta validate --collection blog` addresses one root.
For a one-off run, pass the id directly: `manni meta validate docs/ -s docusaurus:docs:3.10`.

must_not: Do not run `manni meta fill` without `--fields`; the page warns it can rewrite structural fields.
scaffolding: A Docusaurus site with docs/install.md and docs/intro.md (each with a Diataxis `type`), blog/2026-03-14-shipping-v2.md and src/pages/about.md, built from the docusaurus fixtures. No manni.config.yaml: the page has the reader declare the three collections and their overrides, so a spec writes it before `--collection blog`. The `fill --dry-run` example needs a model provider, so it is not expected. The strict-schema tip is conditional advice with no command, so it is not expected either.
